summary.headline: Places of the Luminaries
summary.text: Chapter one explains how the Sun and Moon, their lords, and the lord of the ascendant signify strength, victory, peace, health, security, or unrest according to their places, aspects, reception, and freedom from malefics; it also discusses inimical placements in the sixth, eighth, and twelfth houses.
